about: Ground truth by reading for round 5 (fresh independent attacks) run on iteration 4, written by Claude AFTER the results were seen, independently of what the tool said.

V01-accepts-more-hides-static.note: Tally's constructor only accepts more, so the backstop (which runs only where the comparison finds nothing) did not look; the static method's change rode along unseen.

V02-bound-values-in-mapped-list.note: The meter now refuses 601 to 1440 minutes; billing still states 1 to 1440 for what it accepts. No test of billing fails (its tests use 10, 20 and 2000). The bound test's values sit in a list before .map, which the fingerprint did not read.

V03-refusals-through-console-error.note: console.error writes to standard error; the message rules looked only at write and end.

V04-instance-built-in-a-conditional.note: money's change is wrong (Amounts become class instances, built inside a conditional); bookings, meter, billing and front fail, untold, and money's check did not see it.

V05-error-kind-in-bound-test.note: The error kind changed in code and in the bound test, not in @throws; error kinds named in a test were not counted, and nothing compares a thrown kind with the stated one.

V06-non-interface-file-renamed.note: front imports a file of bookings that is not one of its interface files; no rule forbids it, and the listing does not cover it.

V07-write-with-callback.note: write(line, callback) is right; the tool's description of Node gave write one parameter, and the one-per-line rule looked at every argument.

V08-limit-read-from-json.note: Importing JSON is right on Node 22; the reader was not set to read JSON.

V09-pop-after-length-check.note: pop() after a length check: right; the reader cannot tell, and the value's kind came from another module.

V10-checked-cast-to-kind.note: No refusal: the cast follows a check the reader understands.

V11-door-copy-in-two-steps.note: A copy made by stringify then parse in two statements is not a message; the exemption knew only the one-expression form. billing and front were rightly told of Door's new stated errors.

V12-destructured-parameter.note: Four notices for nothing: the printed declaration changed only by the parameter's written form.

V13-states-named.note: Three notices for nothing: an inline union given a name changes the printed declaration only.

V14-overload-added.note: One notice for nothing: an added overload that keeps the old one only accepts more.

V15-bound-test-through-helper.note: One notice for nothing: values passed to a test helper's parameters were not followed.
